# Objective and completion gate

**Outcome:** we know what evidence is available, what has been examined, and which
source-backed batches will supply the initial release.

Inventory historical USGS editions, modern maps, candidate aerials, and local or agency
records across both counties. Extend the existing acquisition and archive scripts;
USGS historical topo downloads alone do not cover the full period through the present.

**Completion gate:**

- A committed, machine-readable inventory accounts for every quadrangle intersecting
  `aoi_counties.geojson` and every decade from the 1950s through the current decade.
  Each cell identifies verified source IDs or an explicit gap. Distinguish sources
  located, sources examined, trails digitized, and unexamined coverage. A located
  source does not mean its trails have been inspected.
- Search records include search date, collection, geographic/temporal extent, result,
  and unresolved access or evidence gaps. Modern maps, aerials, and local/agency
  records are represented by verified candidates or documented search gaps.
- Selected topo editions from both counties are acquired reproducibly. Record source
  IDs, dates and lineage dates, scale, rights, URLs, and retrieval receipts. New TIFFs
  use content-addressed paths; existing raw files remain unchanged.
- `make test-topo`, `make validate`, `make verify-sources`, `make backup-sources`, and
  `make verify-backup` pass for the receipted acquisition set. Record the receipt
  snapshot and verification results; do not commit raw rasters.
- Select at least four county/decade work batches: at least two distinct decades in
  each county, including one before 2000 and one from 2000 onward in each county.
  Each batch lists its footprint, source IDs, examined foot-trail evidence, review
  tasks, and remaining gaps. Select batches by evidence and coverage benefit, without
  making any locality a prerequisite. Do not invent alignments to meet the minimum.
- Identify at least one obtainable, dated aerial frame for M2, with verified frame ID,
  footprint, rights, and access method. If no suitable frame is obtainable, record the
  blocker; M1 remains incomplete unless the milestone requirement is explicitly revised.

A sheet's printed date does not resolve each feature's observation date. The current
index contains 615 sheets, including pre-1950 material; 149 have later lineage dates,
by up to 28 years. `fetch_topoview.py` preserves those dates in `topo_index.csv`.
See `docs/sources.md`, `docs/topo-editions.md`, and `docs/open-questions.md`.

## Existing work and remaining tasks

County boundaries, the 615-sheet historical topo index, acquisition regression tests, retrieval receipts, and archive tooling already exist. The countywide area/decade coverage inventory, later-period and aerial research, and selected digitizing batches remain outstanding. Indexed or downloaded maps are not reviewed trail observations.

## Child issues and dispatch

This is a milestone tracker, not a single coding assignment. Close children independently and retain this parent until its full completion gate passes. The children below contain the architect-defined implementation contracts.

### Sol coding tasks

- [ ] #9 — M1.1: Define coverage inventory schemas and neutral initial document (coder)
- [ ] #10 — M1.2: Generate the complete county-intersecting quadrangle grid (coder)
- [ ] #11 — M1.3: Build area-by-decade cells and attach candidate source references (coder)
- [ ] #12 — M1.4: Validate inventory references and batch readiness (coder)
- [ ] #13 — M1.5: Add coverage reporting and CI completeness checks (coder)
- [ ] #14 — M1.6: Support explicit topo edition selection in the existing downloader (coder)

### Research, GIS review, operations, and acceptance

- [ ] #15 — M1.7: Research modern maps and agency records for Nevada County (researcher)
- [ ] #16 — M1.8: Research modern maps and agency records for Placer County (researcher)
- [ ] #17 — M1.9: Verify one obtainable aerial frame for the raster pipeline (researcher)
- [ ] #18 — M1.10: Review and select one Nevada digitizing batch before 2000 (GIS reviewer)
- [ ] #19 — M1.11: Review and select one Nevada digitizing batch from 2000 onward (GIS reviewer)
- [ ] #20 — M1.12: Review and select one Placer digitizing batch before 2000 (GIS reviewer)
- [ ] #21 — M1.13: Review and select one Placer digitizing batch from 2000 onward (GIS reviewer)
- [ ] #22 — M1.14: Acquire and archive the reviewed topo selection (source operator)
- [ ] #23 — M1.15: Audit the M1 completion gate and hand off to raster work (engineering reviewer)

### Execution order

| Task | Prerequisites |
| --- | --- |
| #9 | #8; parent #1 accepted |
| #10 | #9; parent #1 accepted |
| #11 | #10; parent #1 accepted |
| #12 | #11; parent #1 accepted |
| #13 | #12; parent #1 accepted |
| #14 | #8; parent #1 accepted |
| #15 | #13; parent #1 accepted |
| #16 | #13; parent #1 accepted |
| #17 | #13; parent #1 accepted |
| #18 | #15, #14; parent #1 accepted |
| #19 | #15, #14; parent #1 accepted |
| #20 | #16, #14; parent #1 accepted |
| #21 | #16, #14; parent #1 accepted |
| #22 | #18, #19, #20, #21; parent #1 accepted |
| #23 | #13, #17, #22; parent #1 accepted |

Serialize tasks sharing files, especially Makefile, README.md, scripts/coverage.py, and coverage.json. Workers must preserve each other's changes. Do not dispatch research/GIS/operator tasks to an autonomous coder. Missing source evidence leaves the relevant task blocked. Each child PR closes only that child, not this milestone.

## Dependencies and closure

Depends on acceptance of M0 (#1). Complete before M2 raster pipeline work.

Close only when every completion criterion above passes, with links to the implementation, committed deliverables, and command/CI results. Do not treat missing evidence as absence of trails. Keep raw data immutable, narrative evidence human-authored, and restricted information out of public artifacts.

These criteria correspond to README §7. The local docs/implementation-plan.md handoff records architecture decisions and the issue index; each child issue is self-contained for implementation.

Two owner decisions are needed before the next coder waves:

1. **#10 (grid):** `data/sources/aoi_counties.geojson` is one dissolved polygon with no per-county geometry, so per-cell `county_geoids` cannot be computed from committed data. Proposed: extend `scripts/fetch_aoi.py counties` to also write a committed per-county file (`data/sources/aoi_county_parts.geojson`, one feature per county, same TIGERweb query and vintage, 6 dp) that the grid command reads. Alternative: name a sanctioned per-county boundary source.
2. **#14 (edition selection):** the issue says to reuse receipts, hash verification, content-addressed paths, and archive code "unchanged", but none of that exists on `main` (`make verify-sources`, `make backup-sources`, `make verify-backup` do not exist; `data/sources/retrievals.jsonl` is untracked and unreferenced). Proposed: implement #14 against the current downloader semantics only and track receipt/archive tooling as a separate issue. This same gap also blocks #22.

Owner decision update: Alec approves retaining separate Nevada and Placer county polygons for internal coverage bookkeeping (the proposed per-county AOI output from the existing TIGERweb fetcher). This is not a requirement to distinguish counties visually in the viewer. For the archive/downloader question, Alec has merged the relevant source-preservation work into main; re-inspect that implementation before #14. The earlier proposal to omit receipt/hash/archive integration is NOT approved. Preserve the existing archive and filename semantics rather than rebuilding or dropping them.

## Goal

Research modern maps and agency records for Nevada County. This is one bounded task under milestone #2.

**Task type:** researcher. Requires the named research/review/operator role; do not dispatch as an autonomous coding task.

**Dependencies:** M1.5 (#13).

## Verified starting point

Repository inspected 2026-09-16. The historical topo collection does not establish coverage through the present; countywide later-period and agency-source searches are outstanding.

## Owned files and responsibility

data/sources/coverage.json candidates/searches and cell links; data/sources/sources.yml for verified collections; docs/sources.md; docs/open-questions.md

## Implementation contract

This is an evidence-research task, not a Sol coding assignment. Work only on Nevada County (06057). Audit candidate modern USGS maps and the county/land-management agency trail or plan collections for 2000–2009, 2010–2019 and 2020 through the actual search date. Use /browse for browsing. Log actual collection/query, footprint/area IDs, decades, search UTC time and result; countywide searches may reference all relevant cells but must accurately describe their scope. An access failure is access_blocked, not no_match. Record verified item metadata and footprints when available; unknown values remain null. Do not claim a modern route existed in earlier decades. Add explicit unsearched or unresolved gaps for cells/decades not covered. Do not add geometry or observation records. Technical automation may assist metadata entry but cannot author trail-history narrative or attest an unperformed review.

## Acceptance criteria

1. All Nevada cells for the three later decades link to actual searches or explicit remaining gaps; no cell is silently dropped.
2. Each verified candidate has traceable source URL/identifier, dates/precision, rights and scope; unknowns remain explicit.
3. The researcher records searched collections, access limitations, and candidate items suitable for later batch inspection; reviewed states require actual inspection.

## Verification

make validate-coverage; make coverage-report; make validate; human citation/footprint check

## Out of scope

No promise that evidence exists, no credentials in git/issues, no digitizing, and no countywide completeness claim based on one source.

## Worker handoff

Implement only this issue. Read AGENTS.md and README.md first. You are not alone in the codebase: preserve other workers' changes and do not revert unrelated edits. One worker owns the listed files for this task; serialize work touching shared files (especially Makefile, README.md, scripts/coverage.py and coverage.json), or rebase isolated branches before integration. Dependencies must be accepted before starting. All M1 work additionally waits for parent M0 acceptance.

Use existing scripts and dependencies. Keep the deliverable static; no backend, browser storage or telemetry. Raw files are immutable. Never invent geometry, citations, source dates, review events or evidence narrative. Do not weaken provenance or public/restricted validation to satisfy a test. If verified inputs are missing, document the gap and leave the issue blocked.

Submit one focused PR with the changed paths, acceptance results and remaining limitations. Run the named tests plus make validate before committing; split data-only changes into data: commits with source attribution. Close only this child issue, not its parent milestone. Rollback for code/docs is reverting the task's commits; a rollback must never delete raw sources or archive objects. Acceptance evidence, not completion of a checklist alone, closes the issue.

## Goal

Verify one obtainable aerial frame for the raster pipeline. This is one bounded task under milestone #2.

**Task type:** researcher. Requires the named research/review/operator role; do not dispatch as an autonomous coding task.

Repository inspected 2026-09-16. No verified aerial frame is currently recorded; candidate EarthExplorer/UCSB collections and access gaps are documented.

## Owned files and responsibility

data/sources/coverage.json aerial candidate/search records; data/sources/sources.yml; docs/sources.md; docs/open-questions.md

## Implementation contract

Research one aerial frame intersecting either county from 1950 onward. Use actual collection search via /browse; never invent a flight/frame number. Record collection_id, source_identifier (exact frame ID), observed URL/access method, capture date or defensible date precision, known footprint/bounds, rights, sensitivity and attribution. Add factual structured fields to the candidate contract only through a separately reviewed schema change if needed; use source_identifier for frame ID and search.note for access method without credentials. Verify access can obtain the actual scan, not just a preview. Public redistribution permission is not required for internal georeferencing, but unknown rights must remain unknown and exclude publication. Record a handoff for a human to place GCPs in M2. If unavailable, leave this issue blocked and document searches; do not substitute a topo or close it as completed.

## Acceptance criteria

1. One verified candidate has actual frame ID, source date, intersecting bounds, rights field, access=available and a verified method to obtain the full scan.
2. Search records capture observed outcomes and dates; any authentication handoff contains no secret.
3. Researcher confirms the metadata and scan refer to the same frame; no georeferencing or historical trail conclusion is claimed.

## Verification

make validate-coverage; make coverage-report; human frame metadata/access review; make validate

## Out of scope

No automated GCP guessing, paid acquisition without authorization, fabricated aerial metadata, or image publication.

## Goal

Review and select one Nevada digitizing batch before 2000. This is one bounded task under milestone #2.

**Task type:** GIS reviewer. Requires the named research/review/operator role; do not dispatch as an autonomous coding task.

**Dependencies:** M1.7 (#15), M1.6 (#14).

## Verified starting point

Repository inspected 2026-09-16. M1 requires four source-backed county/decade batches; authoritative trails remain fixtures, and no specific real batch has been verified.

## Owned files and responsibility

data/sources/coverage.json reviews/batches/cell links; data/sources/mvp-topo-selection.json; docs/open-questions.md

## Implementation contract

Select one bounded locality/reference-cell group in Nevada County (06057) and one study decade before 2000; before-2000 choices must be >=1950. The batch must be based on observed foot-trail evidence, not a canal/road centerline or attractive map coverage. Inspect an actual source at readable scale; record source_ref, precise sheet/page/feature locator, actual reviewer ID/time, reviewed area and county_geoid, partial versus whole-source-footprint scope, and resolved/unresolved dating. Apply M0.2 to distinguish base and revision; unresolved feature dates do not qualify. Use the existing download selection path for a topo if bytes are needed. Add a ready batch only when a positive, date-resolved review supports this county/decade, and list bounded digitizing tasks and remaining gaps. Selection file is {version:1,topo_ids:[...]} and is the sorted union of topo IDs required by all selected batches; preserve other reviewers' entries. If evidence is unavailable, log gaps and leave this issue blocked; do not create synthetic real alignments to satisfy the quota.
This pre-2000 batch must include at least one reviewed historical topo edition intersecting this county, and that topo_id must be included in mvp-topo-selection.json. This establishes the both-counties topo input required by M2 and M1.14. If the available topo does not substantiate a dated foot trail, keep this task blocked; do not claim that source availability is trail evidence.

## Acceptance criteria

1. One ready batch in Nevada and the required era resolves to at least one inspected positive foot-trail review with a precise evidence locator and justified decade.
2. Batch contains county GEOID, area IDs, source IDs, digitizing tasks, review IDs and gaps; it has no fabricated alignment IDs.
3. Selection file includes necessary topo editions without duplicates or removal of other selected batches; source bytes are immutable.
4. The selected historical topo supports this batch and its topo_id is in the committed selection; the Nevada and Placer pre-2000 tasks together guarantee a nonempty both-counties selection.

## Verification

make validate-coverage; make coverage-report; human review of trail identity, feature dating and source locator; make validate

## Out of scope

No actual trail digitizing, automatic feature interpretation, inferred ownership/access rights, or guessing to clear a blocker.
